# Fixture Address Registration

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software tests; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Registering an address

New residents register their address at the Civic Registry within 7 days of moving in. Registration is free of charge.

## 2 Proof of address

The Civic Registry issues a registration certificate that serves as proof of address.
